sn35.159:1.1: sāvatthiyaṃ– rūpe bhikkhave yoniso manasikarotha, rūpāniccatañca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassatha.
sn35.159:1.2: rūpe bhikkhave bhikkhu yoniso manasikaronto rūpāniccatañca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassanto rūpesu nibbindati.
sn35.159:1.10: dhamme bhikkhave bhikkhu yoniso manasi karotha, dhammāniccatañca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassatha.
sn35.159:1.11: dhamme bhikkhave bhikkhu yoniso manasikaronto dhammāniccatañca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassanto dhammesupi nibbindati.
